summary:
CRC outreach, worklist "Okafor CRC 2026" (grp-okafor-crc, 13 members), worked under RBC-QM-02. The measurement period is calendar 2026 and age is counted as of 2026-12-31.

| Patient | Age | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow | 72 | Excluded | Age 66 or older, active frailty diagnosis (cond-00189) and a dementia medication taken in 2025–2026 (donepezil, active since 2025-06, mr-00118). |
| pt-0011 Marilu Gaona | 62 | Open gap: FIT ordered and patient messaged | No qualifying test on record. Her hospice episode ran 2025-06-09 to 2025-10-20, so none of it was in 2026. FIT sr-t0001, message comm-t0009. |
| pt-0014 Santo Pagac | 55 | Open gap: FIT ordered and patient messaged | Colonoscopy was ordered (sr-00002) but he did not attend the 2026-04-14 appointment. An order or appointment doesn't count. FIT sr-t0002, message comm-t0010. |
| pt-0018 Lance Muller | 53 | Open gap: FIT ordered and patient messaged | His stool DNA-FIT sample was collected 2023-12-27, outside the 2024–2026 window (it was resulted 2024-01-08, but collection date counts). His other FIT was in 2021. FIT sr-t0003, message comm-t0011. |
| pt-0019 Harrison O'Keefe | 69 | Open gap: FIT ordered and patient messaged | No screening on record. He has frailty, but no advanced illness, and donepezil was stopped 2023-03-20 (mild cognitive impairment, not dementia). He lives at home. FIT sr-t0004, message comm-t0012. |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan | 52 | Excluded | Hospice episode during 2026 (eoc-00002, active 2026-06-16 to 2026-08-21, now finished). |
| pt-0021 Ángela Vigil | 52 | Excluded | Total proctocolectomy in 2015, documented in a scanned outside operative report (doc-00059). |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss | 52 | Open gap: FIT ordered and patient messaged | Her FIT sample was collected 2025-12-29 and resulted 2026-01-05. Collection date counts, so she has no 2026 FIT. Her past cancers were oral, not colorectal. FIT sr-t0005, message comm-t0013. |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver | 51 | Open gap: FIT ordered and patient messaged | Her stool blood test was on 2024-06-11, so not in 2026. The 2025 colonoscopy order (sr-00003) was never done. FIT sr-t0006, message comm-t0014. |
| pt-0034 Rickey Sipes | 72 | Excluded | Age 66 or older and living long term in a nursing home: his home address is Maple Grove Care Center, Room 214, and he had nursing-facility visits in 2026. |
| pt-0035 Elvin Wolff | 68 | Open gap: FIT ordered and patient messaged | No screening on record. His May 2026 nursing-facility stay was short-term rehab and he went home (doc-00112). No frailty on record. FIT sr-t0007, message comm-t0015. |
| pt-0036 Nick Bartoletti | 53 | Open gap: FIT ordered and patient messaged | No screening on record. His 2021 sigmoid colectomy removed only part of the colon, which does not exclude him. FIT sr-t0008, message comm-t0016. |
| pt-0037 Fumiko Pouros | 35 | Not in the population | Under the 46–75 age range. |

Totals: 0 up to date, 8 open gaps, 4 excluded, 1 not in the population.

- **Orders:** Each open gap got one mailed FIT kit order (LAB-FIT-KIT, routine, window 2026-10-23 to 2026-12-31). None of the 8 had an active FIT order beforehand; the only open orders anywhere in the chart were two colonoscopies and one GI referral.
- **Messages:** Each of the 8 patients got a portal message saying the kit is on its way and explaining how to collect and return it. They ask the patient to tell the clinic about any outside screening.
- **No contact:** Excluded patients and the patient outside the age range got no order and no message, and nothing was written for anyone outside the group.
- **Search limits:** For stool tests I checked each open-gap patient's results back to 2024 and searched the whole chart for the stool-test codes. I didn't page through every record before 2024, but tests that old wouldn't count anyway.
- **Not done:** I didn't write chart notes or create follow-up tasks.
